svg.title: One kernel under two scheduling policies
svg.desc: Two timelines of the uneven kernel on D1 and D2. D1 plays three pi pulses and D2 one, and both readouts start at 120 ns. As late as possible, D2's pulse plays from 80 ns, right before the readouts; as early as possible, from 0 ns, and D2 then idles until it is measured.

g.text: schedule="alap", the default: as late as possible
